_comment_top: Example Claude Code settings.json for ftx-mcp, hardening against untrusted project/runtime content that flows back through read-tool responses (see docs/security.md, 'Untrusted tool-response content', and docs/errors.md '<untrusted> delimiting'). Two protections: (1) 'deny' blocks the classic 'OCR'd/logged text told the agent to curl-pipe-to-shell' escalation path; (2) 'ask' forces a human prompt before any deploy tool writes files or swaps the runtime bundle. Adapt the mcp__<server>__ prefix to the name you registered the server under: this repo's docs use 'ftx-mcp' (README.md / docs/claude-code-setup.md: `claude mcp add --transport http ftx-mcp ...`); if you registered it under another name, rename every mcp__ftx-mcp__ key to match. The 'allow' list is the read-only tool surface and is NOT exhaustive — add the authoring/runtime tools you actually use, and keep the deploy tools OUT of 'allow' so they fall through to 'ask'.
